title: The Reunion (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist Perth Zimbabwe nostalgia
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The school reunion happens every ten years give or take
And the mathematics of who's aged how is the first mistake
You make — looking too hard at the calculus of the face
And forgetting that the room is not a competition for the grace

[Pre-Chorus]
I went to my thirtieth reunion and the people were the same
People in different architecture under different names

[Chorus]
The reunion knows something I don't know
It knows that thirty years is both very long and not the show
The reunion gathers everyone who shared the same coordinates
For three years in the eighties and calls them schoolmates
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
There's always the most successful one and the most unchanged
And the one who peaked at school and is rearranged
Most dramatically by the forty years between the then and the
Right now — the reunion covers all the topology

[Bridge]
I went to my Zimbabwe school reunion once in Perth
Among the diaspora — and people flew from every side of the earth
To stand in a room and talk about the red dust and the time
When we were all in the same country — that was the paradigm

[Outro]
Reunion knows… time was the same for everyone… reunion knows
That's my boy
